items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were all listening to Count Basie.

ctx.x: What were you playing? Just playing by ear?

Of course. We were all listening to Count Basie. So we all knew [Freeman sings a riff from One O’Clock Jump]. We were all playing those – what do you call that thing? It has tissue paper in it? Something like a . . .
